name: Analyze Component Store
description: Reports the size of Windows update leftovers in the component store without deleting any files or repairing issues.

description_i18n.en: Reports the size of Windows update leftovers in the component store without deleting any files or repairing issues.
description_i18n.de: Zeigt die Größe von Update-Resten im Komponentenspeicher an, löscht keine Dateien und behebt keine Probleme selbstständig.
description_i18n.fr: Affiche la taille des résidus de mise à jour dans le magasin de composants sans supprimer de fichiers ni réparer les problèmes.

warnings.title: Read-only Analysis
warnings.message: This tool only reports current status; it does not clean, optimize, or repair the system by itself. Do not delete WinSxS files manually based on this result

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore to inspect the WinSxS folder and report its apparent size The action is a one-shot analysis that does not modify system components or remove files
